title: The Ink Stain Protocol
motive_summary: Blackmail regarding a forgotten narcotics bust from years prior, threatening to dismantle the victim's carefully constructed facade.
overview_text: The smell of stale cigarette smoke and cheap scotch clung to the air in Priya's Flat. The overhead lamp cast weak, yellow pools on the worn carpet. Nadia Cole lay sprawled near a mahogany desk, a dark stain spreading across their tailored trousers. They had been struck once with 'Brass till weight', an object that looked too innocuous to be lethal. It was Elias Grant who made the gruesome find while looking for misplaced files, her breath catching in a ragged whisper as she called out into the oppressive silence.
